description: Read the business card: what the business is, the area it serves, its services (which are booked here, how long each visit holds, and what to do about the rest), what a booking needs (the customer's details, the dog's address and what to ask about the dogs, in booking.petCare), that every booking is a request the business approves, the limits and the cancel rule. Call it first.
name: get_business
title: Get the business
